test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

I am not used **with this kind of work.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "to this kind of work".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"used"** means being accustomed or familiar with something. (आदी होना)

 
 
• **Example:** He is used to waking up early every morning.
 
 
 
• **"to"** is the correct preposition to use with "used" to indicate being accustomed or familiar with something. (तक/के लिए)
 
 
• **Example:** She is used to working under pressure.
 
 
 
• Hence, "to this kind of work" is the most appropriate choice to improve the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: "about this kind of work"** (इस प्रकार के कार्य के बारे में): This option implies knowledge or information about the work, not being accustomed to it.

 
 
• **Example:** I read a book about this kind of work, but I have never done it myself.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: "at this kind of work"** (इस प्रकार के कार्य में): This option implies skill or proficiency in the work, which is not the intended meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very good at this kind of work and always delivers excellent results.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "for this kind of work"** (इस प्रकार के कार्य के लिए): This option implies suitability or purpose, which is not the correct usage in this context.
 
 
• **Example:** This machine is designed for this kind of work.
 
 

147:Tb04,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
